import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import Circle, FancyArrowPatch
BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" SLATE = "#657786" INK = "#263238"
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "text.color": INK, "axes.labelcolor": INK, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "lines.linewidth": 1.6, "svg.fonttype": "none", })
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4), dpi=100) ax_left = fig.add_axes([0.045, 0.19, 0.435, 0.67]) ax_right = fig.add_axes([0.535, 0.19, 0.435, 0.67])
def complex_axes(ax): ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.set_xlim(-1.38, 1.48) ax.set_ylim(-1.20, 1.32) ax.axis("off") ax.add_patch(Circle((0, 0), 1, fill=False, edgecolor=SLATE, linewidth=1.1, alpha=0.55, zorder=1)) for start, end in [ ((-1.19, 0), (1.29, 0)), ((0, -1.12), (0, 1.23)), ]: ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=9, linewidth=1.0, color=SLATE, zorder=2)) ax.text(1.33, -0.055, "Re", fontsize=10, va="center") ax.text(0.075, 1.20, "Im", fontsize=10, va="center") ax.text(-0.065, -0.09, "0", color=SLATE, fontsize=9, ha="right", va="top") ax.text(-1.02, -0.10, r"$-1$", color=SLATE, fontsize=9, ha="center", va="top") ax.text(1.02, -0.10, r"$1$", color=SLATE, fontsize=9, ha="center", va="top")
def vector(ax, endpoint, color, linestyle="-"): ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( (0, 0), endpoint, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=13, linewidth=2.0, color=color, linestyle=linestyle, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, zorder=5))
def angular_arc(ax, radius, start, end, color, arrow=False): angles = np.linspace(start, end, 120) points = np.column_stack((radius * np.cos(angles), radius * np.sin(angles))) ax.plot(points[:, 0], points[:, 1], color=color, linewidth=1.35, zorder=4) if arrow: ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( points[-9], points[-1], arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=10, linewidth=1.35, color=color, zorder=4))
complex_axes(ax_left) complex_axes(ax_right)
fig.text(0.06, 0.935, "a Euler’s formula", fontsize=13, weight="bold") fig.text(0.55, 0.935, "b Phase shift as rotation", fontsize=13, weight="bold")
theta = np.pi / 3 x, y = np.cos(theta), np.sin(theta)
# Orthogonal projections retain the exact unit-circle coordinates. ax_left.plot([x, x], [0, y], "--", color=BLUE, linewidth=1.1, dashes=(3, 3), alpha=0.75, zorder=2) ax_left.plot([0, x], [y, y], "--", color=TEAL, linewidth=1.1, dashes=(3, 3), alpha=0.75, zorder=2) ax_left.plot([0, x], [0, 0], color=BLUE, linewidth=3.1, solid_capstyle="round", zorder=4) ax_left.plot([0, 0], [0, y], color=TEAL, linewidth=3.1, solid_capstyle="round", zorder=4) vector(ax_left, (x, y), INK) ax_left.scatter([x], [y], s=25, color=INK, zorder=6)
angular_arc(ax_left, 0.32, 0, theta, SLATE) ax_left.text(0.42, 0.24, r"$\theta=\pi/3$", fontsize=10) ax_left.text(x + 0.09, y + 0.05, r"$z=e^{i\theta}$", fontsize=11, ha="left", va="bottom") ax_left.text(0.30, -0.21, r"$\cos\theta=0.5$", color=BLUE, fontsize=10, ha="center", va="top") ax_left.text(-0.16, 0.49, r"$\sin\theta$" + "\n" + r"$=\sqrt{3}/2$" + "\n" + r"$\approx 0.866$", color=TEAL, fontsize=10, ha="right", va="center", linespacing=1.35)
fig.text(0.26, 0.105, r"$z=\cos\theta+i\sin\theta=e^{i\theta}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12) fig.text(0.26, 0.045, "Unit circle · dimensionless coordinates", ha="center", color=SLATE, fontsize=9)
# No amplitude measurement is supplied; use a stated unit-amplitude illustration. A = 1.0 theta_0 = np.pi / 6 phi = np.pi / 3 theta_final = theta_0 + phi z0 = A * np.array([np.cos(theta_0), np.sin(theta_0)]) z_final = A * np.array([np.cos(theta_final), np.sin(theta_final)])
vector(ax_right, z0, BLUE) vector(ax_right, z_final, TEAL) ax_right.scatter(*z0, s=24, color=BLUE, zorder=6) ax_right.scatter(*z_final, s=24, color=TEAL, zorder=6)
angular_arc(ax_right, 0.31, 0, theta_0, BLUE) ax_right.text(0.45, 0.105, r"$\theta_0=\pi/6$", color=BLUE, fontsize=10, va="center") angular_arc(ax_right, 0.72, theta_0, theta_final, TEAL, arrow=True) ax_right.text(0.62, 0.83, r"$\phi=\pi/3$", color=TEAL, fontsize=10, ha="left") ax_right.text(0.97, 0.52, r"$z_0$", color=BLUE, fontsize=12, ha="left", va="center") ax_right.text(-0.13, 1.06, r"$z$", color=TEAL, fontsize=12, ha="right", va="bottom") ax_right.text(0.05, -0.42, r"$\theta=\theta_0+\phi=\pi/2$", fontsize=11, ha="left") ax_right.text(0.05, -0.67, r"Multiply by $e^{i\phi}$", color=SLATE, fontsize=10, ha="left")
fig.text(0.755, 0.105, r"$z=z_0\,e^{i\phi}=A\,e^{i\theta_0}\,e^{i\phi}" r"=A\,e^{i(\theta_0+\phi)}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11) fig.text(0.755, 0.045, r"Illustrated with $A=1$ · counterclockwise rotation", ha="center", color=SLATE, fontsize=9)
